feature_ablation.expert_plus_data_includes: all frozen schedule and workload features

sparse_calibration.leakage_policy: Only design and validation target rows may enter calibration. Holdout runtimes are revealed after the complete candidate ordering is frozen. Label-free feature scaling uses design and validation candidate metadata only.

transformer_pool.cpu_affinity_policy: one detected performance core on i9; one RT-Smart process on K230
transformer_pool.correctness: deterministic projection check outside the timed region

mechanism_counters.i9: perf stat on the pool-best generated schedule and complete BLIS when kernel permissions allow
mechanism_counters.k230: in-adapter pack-A, pack-B, microkernel, scatter, kernel-call and fringe-call counters

acceptance.sparse_expert_increment: At calibration budget <= 20, D1/D0 cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound must exceed 1.0 on both x86 hosts.
acceptance.common_pool_oracle: D0 and D1 must consume the same workload-specific candidate pool and therefore share the same oracle.
acceptance.independent_backend: After the generator hash is frozen, the K230 path may add only a Contract descriptor, package-local candidate data, the OpenBLAS packing/call adapter, and deployment code.
acceptance.realistic_workloads: Report every workload, complete-library ratio, direct/adapt path, correctness, and total tuning plus execution cost; do not claim full-model speedup.

claim_boundary: This extension evaluates sparse target calibration, realistic Transformer GEMM shapes, and a second library/ISA microkernel package. It remains single-threaded, row-major, f32/f64 GEMM evidence rather than an end-to-end model or universal backend result.
